commands.whoami: Sends back information about who you are.
commands.whois: [user] Sends back information about the user specified.
commands.discord: Allows linking of your discord account to your BAR account.
commands.mute: [username] Mutes that user and prevents you seeing their messages.
commands.unmute: [username] Un-mutes that user and allows you to see their messages.
commands.coc: [term] Searches the code of conduct and returns items with a textual match in them.
commands.joinq: Adds you to the queue to join when a space opens up, you will be automatically added to the game as a player. If already a member it has no effect.
commands.leaveq: Removes you from the join queue.
commands.status: Status info about the battle lobby.
commands.splitLobby: [minimum players] Causes a vote to start where other players can elect to join you in splitting the lobby, follow someone of their choosing or remain in place. After 30 seconds, if at least the minimum number of players agreed to split, you are moved to a new (empty) lobby and those that voted yes or are following someone that voted yes are also moved to that lobby.
commands.roll:
[range] Rolls a random number based on the range format.
- Dice format: nDs, where n is number of dice and s is sides of die. E.g. 4D6 - 4 dice with 6 sides are rolled
- Max format: N, where N is a number and an integer between 1 and N is returned
- Min/Max format: MN MX, where each is a number and an integer between them (inclusive) is returned
commands.explain: Lists a log of the steps taken to calculate balance for the lobby
commands.resetApproval: Resets the list of approved players to just the ones present at the moment (approved players are able to join even if it is locked and without needing a password). Requires boss privileges.
commands.meme: [meme] A predefined bunch of settings for meme games. It's all Rikerss' fault. Requires boss privileges. ticks: Ticks only!, nodefence: No defences, greenfields: No metal extractors, rich: Infinite money, poor: No money generation, hardt1: T1 but no seaplanes or hovers either, crazy: Random combination of several settings, undo: Removes all meme effects
commands.welcomeMessage: [message] Sets the welcome message sent to anybody joining the lobby. Run this command without a message to clear the existing message. Requires boss privileges. Use $$ to add a line return.
commands.gatekeeper: [default - friends - friendsplay - clan] sets the gatekeeper for this battle. Requires boss privileges. > default: no limitations. > friends allows only friends of existing members to join the lobby. > friendsplay: allows only friends of existing players to become players (but anybody can join to spectate)
commands.rename: [new name] Renames the lobby to the name given. Requires boss privileges.
commands.resetRatingLevels: Resets the rating level limits to not exist. Player limiting commands are designed to be used with $rename, please be careful not to abuse them. Requires boss privileges.
commands.minRatingLevel: [min-level] Sets the minimum level for players, you must be at least this rating to be a player. Requires boss privileges.
commands.maxRatingLevel: [max-level] Sets the maximum level for players, you must be at below this rating to be a player. Requires boss privileges.
commands.setRatingLevels: [min-level] [max-level] Sets the minimum and maximum rating levels for players. Requires boss privileges.

engine.loading: Available settings are being read from the engine, please wait...
engine.deviceOnly: Kept on this device only, not synced
engine.hideSpecChatPlayerDescription: Not showing any spectator chat when being a player.
engine.displayDpsDescription: Display the damage per second done where targets are hit.
engine.containMouseDescription: In windowed mode, stops the mouse from moving out of the window.
engine.edgeScrollWidthDescription: How close to the screen's edge the camera starts to scroll, as a fraction of the screen.
engine.limitIdleFpsDescription: Reduces FPS when idle for a minute. Camera movement ends idle mode.
engine.nanoParticleLightsDescription: Adds light sources to nano particles used for building and repairing.
engine.doubleClickTimeDescription: Time in ms between two consecutive left clicks to be considered a double-click.
engine.edgeScrollDynamicDescription: Scrolling speed fades with the distance from the screen's edge.
engine.cameraHeightDescription: How the camera's height changes as it moves over uneven terrain.
engine.airAbsorptionDescription: Muffles distant sounds, so when in your base or zoomed out, front battles are heard as only low frequencies.
engine.zoomFadeoutDescription: How much battle sounds fade out as you zoom out.
engine.muteOffscreenDescription: The game mutes itself while the mouse is outside its window.
engine.widgetSelectorDescription: Allows opening the widget selector with F11.

descriptions.AllowDeferredMapRendering: Enable rendering the map to the map deferred buffers.
descriptions.AllowDeferredModelRendering: Allows the rendering of model deferred buffers.
descriptions.AllowMultiSampledFrameBuffers: Enable FBOs that can have multisampled anti-aliasing.
descriptions.AllowSpectatorJoin: allow any unauthenticated clients to join as spectator with any name, name will be prefixed with ~
descriptions.AtiHacks:
Enables graphics drivers workarounds for users with AMD proprietary drivers.
 -1:=runtime detect, 0:=off, 1:=on
descriptions.AutoAddBuiltUnitsToFactoryGroup: Controls whether or not units built by factories will inherit that factory's unit group.
descriptions.AutohostPort: Which port should the engine listen on for Autohost interfact connections.
descriptions.BlockCompositing: Disables kwin compositing to fix tearing, possible fixes low FPS in windowed mode, too.
descriptions.BumpWaterEndlessOcean: Sets whether Bumpmapped water will be drawn beyond the map edge.
descriptions.BumpWaterReflection:
Determines the amount of objects reflected in Bumpmapped water.
0:=off, 1:=fast (skip terrain), 2:=full
descriptions.BumpWaterRefraction:
Determines the method of refraction with Bumpmapped water.
0:=off, 1:=screencopy, 2:=own rendering cycle (disabled)
descriptions.BumpWaterTexSizeReflection: Sets the size of the framebuffer texture used to store the reflection in Bumpmapped water.
descriptions.CamFrameTimeCorrection: Sets wether the camera interpolation factor should be the inverse of fps or last draw frame time (0 = lastdrawframetime, 1 = fpsinv)
descriptions.CamFreeAutoTilt: When free camera is locked, AutoTilt will point the camera in the direction of the ground's slope
descriptions.CamFreeGravity: When free camera is locked, Gravity will be used if you jump off of a ground ramp.
descriptions.CamFreeGroundOffset:
Determines ground handling for the free camera.
0 - the camera can move anywhere,
< 0 - the camera is always offset from the ground height by -CamFreeGroundOffset
> 0 - the camera can be "locked" to the ground by using SHIFT UP_ARROW. (and will use CamFreeGroundOffset as the offset). To release the lock, simply press SHIFT DOWN_ARROW.
descriptions.CamMode:
Defines the used camera. Options are:
0 = FPS
1 = Overhead
2 = Spring
3 = RotOverhead
4 = Free
5 = Overview
descriptions.CamOverviewDynamicRotation: Transition from different camera preserves rotation
descriptions.CamSpringEdgeRotate: Rotate camera when cursor touches screen borders.
descriptions.CamSpringFastScaleMouseMove: Scaling for CameraMoveFastMult in spring camera mode while moving mouse.
descriptions.CamSpringFastScaleMousewheelMove: Scaling for CameraMoveFastMult in spring camera mode while scrolling with mouse.
descriptions.CamSpringHalflife: For Spring Dampened camera. It is the time in milliseconds at which the camera should be approximately halfway towards the goal.
descriptions.CamSpringLockCardinalDirections: Whether cardinal directions should be `locked` for a short time when rotating.
descriptions.CamSpringMinZoomDistance: Minimum camera zoom distance, note this is the distance from frustrum location to the ground in the direction of view
descriptions.CamSpringTrackMapHeightMode: Camera height is influenced by terrain height. 0=Static 1=Terrain 2=Smoothmesh
descriptions.CamTimeExponent: Camera transitions happen at lerp(old, new, timeNorm ^ CamTimeExponent).
descriptions.CamTimeFactor: Scales the speed of camera transitions, e.g. zooming or position change.
descriptions.CamTransitionMode:
Defines the function used for camera transitions. Options are:
0 = Exponential Decay
1 = Spring Dampened
2 = Spring Dampened with timed transitions
3 = Lerp Smoothed
descriptions.CameraMoveFastMult: The multiplier applied to speed when camera is in movefast state.
descriptions.CameraMoveSlowMult: The multiplier applied to speed when camera is in moveslow state.
descriptions.ColorElev: If heightmap (default hotkey [F1]) should be colored or not.
descriptions.CompressTextures: Runtime compress most textures to save VideoRAM.
descriptions.CubeTexGenerateMipMaps: Generate mipmaps for the reflection and specular cubemap textures, useful for efficient subsampling and blurring.
descriptions.CubeTexSizeReflection: The square resolution of each face of the environment reflection cubemap.
descriptions.CubeTexSizeSpecular: The square resolution of each face of the specular cubemap.
descriptions.DWMFlush: Force Windows Desktop Compositors DWMFlush before each SDL_GL_SwapWindow, preventing dropped frames (use nVidias FrameView to validate dropped frames, or BARs Jitter Timer widget). Value of 1 does DWMFlush before SwapBuffers, value of 2 does DWMFlush after swapbuffers.
descriptions.DebugGL: Enables GL debug-context and output. (see GL_ARB_debug_output)
descriptions.DebugGLReportGroups: Show OpenGL PUSH/POP groups in the GL debug
descriptions.DebugGLStacktraces: Create a stacktrace when an OpenGL error occurs
descriptions.DefaultLuaMenu: Sets the default menu to be used when spring is started.
descriptions.DefaultStartScript: filename of script.txt to use when no command line parameters are specified.
descriptions.DemoFileExtension: Comma-separated list of replay file extensions. The first entry is used when recording; all entries are accepted when loading. Set by the lobby (e.g. 'barreplay,sdfz' for BAR).
descriptions.DemoFromDemo: Enable recording a demo while playing back a demo.
descriptions.DisableDemoVersionCheck: Allow to play every replay file (may crash / cause undefined behaviour in replays)
descriptions.DualScreenMiniMapAspectRatio: Whether minimap preserves aspect ratio on dual screen mode.
descriptions.DualScreenMiniMapOnLeft: When set, will make the left half of the screen the minimap when DualScreenMode is set.
descriptions.DualScreenMode: Sets whether to split the screen in half, with one half for minimap and one for main screen. Right side is for minimap unless DualScreenMiniMapOnLeft is set.
descriptions.DumpGameStateOnDesync: Enable writing clientgamestate and servergamestate dumps when a desync is detected
descriptions.EdgeMoveDynamic: If EdgeMove scrolling speed should fade with edge distance.
descriptions.EdgeMoveWidth: The width (in percent of screen size) of the EdgeMove scrolling area.
descriptions.FeatureDrawDistance: Maximum distance at which features will be drawn.
descriptions.FeatureFadeDistance: Distance at which features will begin to fade from view.
descriptions.FontConfigApplySubstitutions: [EXPERIMENTAL] In case it's disabled FcConfigSubstitute is not getting called, this might break non-ASCII font rendering.
descriptions.FontConfigSearchAttributes: Whether the font characteristics will used to refine the search by fontconfig. Results in better glyph matches in some cases, but has a nontrivial performance cost.
descriptions.FontFile: Sets the font of Spring engine text.
descriptions.FontOutlineWeight: Sets the opacity of Spring engine text, such as the title screen version number, clock, and basic UI. Does not affect LuaUI elements.
descriptions.FontOutlineWidth: Sets the width of the black outline around Spring engine text, such as the title screen version number, clock, and basic UI. Does not affect LuaUI elements.
descriptions.FontSize: Sets the font size (in pixels) of the MainMenu and more.
descriptions.Fullscreen: Sets whether the game will run in fullscreen, as opposed to a window. For Windowed Fullscreen of Borderless Window, set this to 0, WindowBorderless to 1, and WindowPosX and WindowPosY to 0.
descriptions.FullscreenEdgeMove: see WindowedEdgeMove, just for fullscreen mode
descriptions.GrassDetail: Sets how detailed the engine rendered grass will be on any given map.
descriptions.GroundDecals: Controls whether ground decals underneath buildings, unit tracks & footprints as well as ground scars from explosions will be rendered.
descriptions.GroundDetail: Controls how detailed the map geometry will be. On lowered settings, cliffs may appear to be jagged or "melting".
descriptions.GuiOpacity: Sets the opacity of the built-in Spring UI. Generally has no effect on LuaUI widgets. Can be set in-game using shift+, to decrease and shift+. to increase.
descriptions.HangTimeout: Number of seconds that, if spent in the same code segment, indicate a hang; -1 to disable.
descriptions.HardwareCursor: Sets hardware mouse cursor rendering. If you have a low framerate, your mouse cursor will seem "laggy". Setting hardware cursor will render the mouse cursor separately from spring and the mouse will behave normally. Note, not all GPU drivers support it in fullscreen mode!
descriptions.HighQualityDecals: Forces MSAA processing of decals. Improves decals quality, but may ruin the performance.
descriptions.HostIPDefault: Default IP to use for hosting if not specified in script.txt
descriptions.HostPortDefault: Default Port to use for hosting if not specified in script.txt
descriptions.InfoMessageTime: Time until old messages disappear from the ingame console.
descriptions.InitialNetworkTimeout: Time to wait for the initial connection to the game server.
descriptions.KeyChainTimeout: Timeout in milliseconds waiting for a key chain shortcut.
descriptions.LastSelectedSetting: Stores the previously selected setting, when editing settings within the Spring main menu.
descriptions.LoadingMT: Experimental option to load the game in separate thread. Expect visual glitches, crashes and deadlocks
descriptions.LogFlushLevel: Flush the logfile when a message's level exceeds this value. ERROR is flushed by default, WARNING is not.
descriptions.LogRepeatLimit: Allow at most this many consecutive identical messages to be logged. Set to 0 to disable the limit.
descriptions.LogSections: Comma-separated list of enabled logsections, use this for log filtering by setting log level for each sections. See infolog.txt / console output for possible values.
descriptions.LuaGarbageCollectionMemLoadMult: How much the amount of Lua memory in use increases the rate of garbage collection.
descriptions.LuaGarbageCollectionRunTimeMult: How many milliseconds the garbage collected can run for in each GC cycle
descriptions.LuaSocketEnabled: Enable LuaSocket support, allows Lua widgets to make TCP/UDP connections
descriptions.MSAALevel: Enables multisample anti-aliasing; 'level' is the number of samples used.
descriptions.MapBorder: Draws a solid border at the edges of the map.
descriptions.MaxDynamicMapLights: Maximum number of map-global dynamic lights that will be rendered at once. High numbers of lights cost performance, as they affect every map fragment.
descriptions.MaxFontTries: Represents the maximum number of attempts to search for a glyph replacement using the FontConfig library (lower = foreign glyphs may fail to render, higher = searching for foreign glyphs can lag the game).
descriptions.MaxPinnedFonts: Maximum number of fonts to pin to cache. Increasing this will eventually use more memory, but can alleviate processing spikes when rendering new glyphs.
descriptions.MaxTextureAtlasSizeX: The max X size of the projectile and Lua texture atlasses
descriptions.MaxTextureAtlasSizeY: The max Y size of the projectile and Lua texture atlasses
descriptions.MenuArchive: Archive name for the default Menu.
descriptions.MinDrawFPS: Defines how many frames per second should minimally be rendered. To reach this number we will delay simframes.
descriptions.MinSampleShadingRate: A value of 1.0 indicates that each sample in the framebuffer should be independently shaded. A value of 0.0 effectively allows the GL to ignore sample rate shading. Any value between 0.0 and 1.0 allows the GL to shade only a subset of the total samples within each covered fragment.
descriptions.MinSimDrawBalance: Percent of the time for simulation is minimum spend for drawing. E.g. if set to 0.15 then 15% of the total cpu time is exclusively reserved for drawing.
descriptions.MiniMapCanDraw: Enables drawing with cursor over MiniMap.
descriptions.MiniMapCanFlip: Whether minimap inverts coordinates when camera Y rotation is between 90 and 270 degrees natively (1) or hands Lua control (0).
descriptions.MiniMapDrawPings: Whether to draw pings on the minimap.
descriptions.MiniMapMouseWheel: Whether MiniMap responds to MouseWheel events
descriptions.MiniMapRefreshRate: The refresh rate of the async MiniMap texture. Needs MiniMapRenderToTexture to be true. Value of "0" autoselects between 10-60FPS.
descriptions.MiniMapRenderToTexture: Asynchronous render MiniMap to a texture independent of screen FPS.
descriptions.MinimizeOnFocusLoss: When set to 1 minimize Window if it loses key focus when in fullscreen mode.
descriptions.MouseDragBoxCommandThreshold: Distance in pixels which the mouse must be dragged to trigger a rectangular area command.
descriptions.MouseDragCircleCommandThreshold: Distance in pixels which the mouse must be dragged to trigger a circular area command.
descriptions.MouseDragFrontCommandThreshold: Distance in pixels which the mouse must be dragged to trigger a formation front command.
descriptions.MouseDragSelectionThreshold: Distance in pixels which the mouse must be dragged to trigger a selection box.
descriptions.NetworkTimeout: Number of seconds before connection to game server is considered lost.
descriptions.OverheadMaxHeightFactor: Float multiplier for maximum overhead camera zoom distance
descriptions.PitchAdjust: Adjusts sound pitch proportional to [if set to 1, the square root of] game speed. Set to 2 for linear scaling.
descriptions.PreloadModels: The engine will preload all models
descriptions.ROAM: Use ROAM for terrain mesh rendering: 0 to disable, 1=VBO mode to enable.
descriptions.RapidTagResolutionOrder: ';' separated list of domains, preference order for resolving package from rapid tags
descriptions.ReconnectTimeout: On client defines time to wait before reconnection is initiated with the server. On server defines time to wait before reconnection from unknown address can be accepted. Reconnect is required only when client's address changed during the game. Value needs to be smaller than the value of 'InitialNetworkTimeout' and 'NetworkTimeout' to trigger. Value '0' disables the feature on server or client side.
descriptions.RotateLogFiles: Rotate logfiles, old logfiles will be moved into the subfolder "log".
descriptions.SMFTextureLodBias: In case SMFTextureStreaming = false, this parameter controls the sampling lod bias applied to diffuse texture
descriptions.SMFTextureStreaming: Dynamically load and unload SMF Diffuse textures. Saves VRAM, worse performance and image quality.
descriptions.ScreenshotCounter: Deprecated, does nothing, but not marked as such to keep compatibility with older engine versions
descriptions.SelectThroughGround: How far beyond the ground to allow selecting objects.
descriptions.ServerSleepTime: Number of milliseconds to sleep per tick for the server thread. Lower values have marginally higher CPU load, while high values can introduce additional latency.
descriptions.SetCoreAffinity: Defines a bitmask indicating which CPU cores the main-thread should use.
descriptions.ShadowColorMode: Whether the colorbuffer of shadowmap FBO is RGB vs greyscale(to conserve some VRAM)
descriptions.ShadowMapSize: Sets the resolution of shadows. Higher numbers increase quality at the cost of performance.
descriptions.Shadows:
Sets whether shadows are rendered.
-1:=forceoff, 0:=off, 1:=full, 2:=fast (skip terrain)
descriptions.ShowClock: Displays a clock on the top-right corner of the screen showing the elapsed time of the current game.
descriptions.SmallFontFile: Sets the font of Spring engine small text.
descriptions.SmallFontSize: Sets the font size (in pixels) of the engine GUIs and more.
descriptions.SmoothTimeOffset: Enables frametimeoffset smoothing, 0 = off (old version), -1 = forced 0.5,  1-20 smooth, recommended = 2-3
descriptions.SoftParticles: Soften up CEG particles on clipping edges
descriptions.SpeedControl: Sets how server adjusts speed according to player's load (CPU), 1: use average, 2: use highest
descriptions.SpringData: List of additional data-directories, separated by ';' on Windows and ':' on other OSs
descriptions.SpringDataRoot: Optional custom data-directory content root ('base', 'maps', ...) to scan for archives
descriptions.StoreDefaultSettings: springsettings.cfg will save the settings values, if they match the implicit defaults and were set by a user explicitly
descriptions.TextDisableOldColorIndicators: Disable support for old color indicators. The old color indicators don't allow writing some characters.
descriptions.TextureMemPoolSize: Set to 0 to disable, otherwise specify a predefined memory to serve Bitmap allocation requests
descriptions.ThreadPinPolicy: Thread to CPU Pinning Policy (0) = Off; (1) = System Default; (2) = Exclusive Performance Core; (3) = Share Performance Cores
descriptions.UnitGhostIconsDimming: Dimming multiplier for out of radar ghost icons. Setting to 0 disables them.
descriptions.UnitIconsAsUI: Draw unit icons like it is an UI element and not like unit's LOD.
descriptions.UnitIconsHideWithUI: Hide unit icons when UI is hidden.
descriptions.UseFontConfigLib: Whether the system fontconfig library (if present and enabled at compile-time) should be used for handling fonts.
descriptions.UseFontConfigSystemFonts: Whether the system fonts will be searched by fontconfig.
descriptions.UseHighResTimer: On Windows, sets whether Spring will use low- or high-resolution timer functions for tasks like graphical interpolation between game frames.
descriptions.UseLuaMemPools: Whether Lua VM memory allocations are made from pools.
descriptions.UseNetMessageSmoothingBuffer: Buffer network packets for a few frames in an attempt to reduce lag from packet time variance. Introduces a fixed lag.
descriptions.UseSDLAudio: If enabled, OpenAL-soft only renders audio into a SDL buffer and playback is done by the SDL audio layer, i.e. SDL handles the hardware
descriptions.UseShaderCache: If already compiled shaders should be shared via a cache, reducing compiles of already compiled shaders.
descriptions.VSync: Synchronize buffer swaps with vertical blanking interval. Modes are -N (adaptive), +N (standard), or 0 (disabled).
descriptions.Water: Defines the type of water rendering. Can be set in game. Options are: 0 = Basic water, 1 = Reflective water, 2 = Reflective and Refractive water, 3 = Dynamic water, 4 = Bumpmapped water
descriptions.WindowBorderless: When set and Fullscreen is 0, will put the game in Borderless Window mode, also known as Windowed Fullscreen. When using this, it is generally best to also set WindowPosX and WindowPosY to 0
descriptions.WindowPosX: Sets the horizontal position of the game window, if Fullscreen is 0. When WindowBorderless is set, this should usually be 0.
descriptions.WindowPosY: Sets the vertical position of the game window, if Fullscreen is 0. When WindowBorderless is set, this should usually be 0.
descriptions.WindowedEdgeMove: Sets whether moving the mouse cursor to the screen edge will move the camera across the map.
descriptions.WorkerThreadCount: Number of workers (including the main thread!) used by ThreadPool.
descriptions.XResolution: Sets the width of the game screen. If set to 0 Spring will autodetect the current resolution of your desktop.
